notes.zh-Hans:
维珀 0.1.0（3）内部测试

修复取消生成后的清理与重试竞态；清理结束前不会接受下一次生成，后台停止流程会正确释放后台额度。
修复 iPhone Duo 展开并旋转后预览区消失的问题。

请重点测试：生成中取消、取消后再次生成、切出后返回、保存并重新打开作品。超过100秒的停止场景尚未在新版实机复现，仍需验证。

本机AI需要12GB或以上内存。首次从Apple下载Qwen3.5 4B INT4素材，校验安装后可离线使用。复杂造型的成功率、结构和细节仍处于早期阶段，可能生成失败或需要手动调整。
notes.en-US:
Voxamber 0.1.0 (3), internal test

Fixes cleanup/retry races after cancellation. Another generation is admitted only after cleanup; background assertions are ended correctly.
Fixes the missing viewport after unfolding and rotating iPhone Duo.

Please test cancellation, retry, returning from background, and saving/reopening work. The reported stop lasting over 100 seconds has not been reproduced on a phone with this revision and still needs verification.

On-device AI requires 12 GB RAM. Download the Qwen3.5 4B INT4 asset pack from Apple once; after verification it runs offline. Complex shape success rate, structure and detail are still early; generation may fail or need manual editing.
